title: The review threads beside a diff in nvim
description: The file PRS_DIFF_THREADS names in the nvim gotermboard's NvimDiff hands the terminal to. NvimDiffHandover.Ended removes it once nvim exits. A pull request's diff carries slug, number, url, base and head. A session's diff has no pull request, so it carries sessions instead.

diff.description: Which diff opened. whole runs three-dot from where a pull request's branch left its base branch. since_review runs from the commit the newest review read to the head. session is the commits sessions made, a tab per repo.

title.description: What the diff shows, as the panel titles it.

slug.description: owner/name of the pull request's repository. A Bitbucket owner is the project key.

base.description: The revision the diff runs from, which is its left side's: origin/<base branch> for whole, where the left side is where the branch left it, and the reviewed commit for since_review.

head.description: The commit fetched for the pull request's head, which is the diff's right side.

sessions.description: The Claude Code session ids whose commits a session diff shows.

threads_read.description: False where the writer held no read of the threads when the diff opened, so an empty threads list says nothing.

threads.description: Each review thread on a side the diff shows, in the provider's order. That is every one for whole, the RIGHT ones for since_review, whose left side is not the base branch's copy, and none for session.

path.description: The file's path from the repository's root.

line.description: The line the thread is on, counted in the copy of the file side names, and null where that line is gone from the diff.

side.description: LEFT where line counts in the base's copy of the file, and RIGHT where it counts in the head's.

outdated.description: True where the lines it was left on changed since.

comments.description: The thread's comments, oldest first, as many as the writer read.

author.description: The login that wrote it, and empty for a deleted account.

author_type.description: The author's kind, such as User or Bot, in the provider's words, and empty where it does not say.

author_association.description: What the author is to the repo, such as OWNER, COLLABORATOR or NONE, in the provider's words, and empty where it does not say.

comment_count.description: How many comments the thread holds, which can pass the number listed.

threads_left_out.description: How many threads the writer read on a side this diff does not show: 0 for whole and session, and the LEFT ones for since_review.
